title: Barriers to Foreign Aid Delivery in Conflict Zones: A Critical Literature Review
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London

detail.title: Barriers to Foreign Aid Delivery in Conflict Zones: A Critical Literature Review
detail.abstract: Foreign aid is critical for populations affected by armed conflict, yet its delivery is frequently obstructed by political agendas, security dynamics, and operational constraints. This literature review critically examines the mechanisms, motivations, and consequences of aid obstruction in conflict zones. The analysis identifies a range of actors such as state authorities, non-state armed groups, donor governments, and even aid organizations themselves, whose actions impede humanitarian access. Tactics include bureaucratic barriers, denial of movement, targeted violence against aid workers, and conditional aid tied to political objectives. Donor-driven strategies often prioritize foreign policy interests over humanitarian principles, while anti-terrorism laws further restrict operations. Internal shortcomings within the aid system, such as excessive security measures and inadequate local engagement, compound these challenges. The implications are profound: obstruction intensifies civilian suffering, undermines neutrality, fosters dependency, and can prolong conflict. The review emphasizes the need for adaptive, context-sensitive approaches that reinforce local participation, uphold humanitarian norms, and ensure accountability from both donors and operational agencies. Addressing these structural and political barriers is essential to safeguarding the integrity and effectiveness of humanitarian aid in the world's most volatile environments.

AI.tldr: 本文献综述批判性分析了冲突地区援助受阻的机制、动机和后果，识别了阻碍人道主义援助的多方行为体及其策略，强调了适应性、情境敏感的方法和加强地方参与的重要性。
AI.research_question: 冲突地区人道主义援助受阻的机制、动机和后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 武装冲突影响地区的人道主义援助对受灾民众至关重要，但其交付经常因政治议程、安全动态和操作限制而受阻，需要系统分析这些障碍及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人道主义援助政治学、冲突分析和国际关系理论，分析多方行为体在援助受阻中的角色和互动机制。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和分析现有关于冲突地区援助受阻的研究文献和实证证据。
AI.findings: 识别了国家当局、非国家武装团体、捐助国政府甚至援助组织本身等多方行为体；发现了官僚障碍、行动限制、针对援助人员的暴力以及附带政治条件的援助等策略；捐助国策略常将外交政策利益置于人道原则之上；反恐法律进一步限制行动；援助体系内部缺陷加剧挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了冲突地区援助受阻的综合分析框架，揭示了政治议程与人道主义原则之间的张力，丰富了人道主义援助政治经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了适应性、情境敏感的方法建议，强调加强地方参与、维护人道主义规范和确保捐助方与运营机构问责制，为改善冲突地区援助交付提供实践指导。

title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
affiliations: University of Wisconsin - Madison - Department of Economics, National Taiwan University - Department of Finance and University of Calgary - Department of Economics

detail.title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
detail.abstract:
College loans serve as a double-edged sword for human capital investment: While they facilitate access to education, the burden of repayment may distort post-education investments in human capital. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model in which heterogeneous individuals, faced with borrowing limits, make dynamic decisions on consumption, borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment (via both college education and on-the-job learning a la Ben-Porath (1967)). We estimate two versions of the model using data from the NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations based on both models suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income-driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare. Although some generous IDR plans may result in losses for the loan program itself, overall government revenue is higher under IDRs than under the standard repayment plan when lifetime income taxes are accounted for, creating a win-win scenario for both individual welfare and government revenue.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 大学贷款是一把双刃剑：虽然促进教育机会，但还款负担可能扭曲毕业后的人力资本投资。研究发现，相对于标准固定还款计划，收入驱动型还款计划能适度提高教育程度、终身收入和个体福利，同时增加政府税收收入。
AI.research_question: 大学贷款和还款政策如何影响个体的人力资本投资决策和终身福利？
AI.motivation: 大学贷款在促进教育机会的同时，其还款负担可能对毕业后的持续人力资本投资产生扭曲效应，需要研究不同还款政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ben-Porath（1967）人力资本投资理论的结构模型，考虑异质性个体在借贷限制下的动态决策，包括消费、借贷/储蓄、劳动供给和人力资本投资。
AI.method: 使用NLSY79数据估计两个版本的结构模型：一个具有自然借贷限制，另一个具有参数化限制，并进行反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: 收入驱动型还款计划相对于标准固定还款计划，能适度提高教育程度、终身收入和个体福利；虽然某些慷慨的IDR计划可能导致贷款项目亏损，但考虑终身所得税后政府总收入更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了人力资本投资理论，将大学贷款和还款政策纳入动态决策框架，提供了分析教育融资政策影响的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证证据，表明收入驱动型还款计划能够实现个体福利和政府收入的双赢，为教育贷款政策设计提供了参考。

title: Managing Waste or Wasting Management? A Critique of Republic Act 9003 or the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
affiliations: and

detail.title: Managing Waste or Wasting Management? A Critique of Republic Act 9003 or the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000

keywords: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000

detail.abstract: This critique examines the implementation and effectiveness of Republic Act No. 9003, also known as the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, which was designed to address the Philippines' growing solid waste management challenges. The Act introduced an institutional framework through the National Solid Waste Management Commission (NSWMC) and mandated local government units (LGUs) to develop 10-year solid waste management plans focusing on waste reduction, recycling, and environmental sustainability. While RA 9003 has strengths such as its participatory approach, institutional depth, and potential for environmental and economic benefits, it suffers from critical weaknesses including inadequate funding, weak enforcement, limited infrastructure, and low public awareness. These challenges have hindered full compliance, as shown by the continued existence of open dumpsites and limited access to sanitary landfills and Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs). The critique recommends increased funding, stronger enforcement mechanisms, public-private partnerships, and comprehensive education campaign.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了菲律宾《生态固体废物管理法》（RA 9003）的实施效果，指出了该法律在资金不足、执法薄弱、基础设施有限和公众意识低下等方面的关键缺陷，并提出了增加资金、强化执法机制、公私合作和全面教育等建议。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾《生态固体废物管理法》（RA 9003）的实施效果如何？存在哪些关键挑战和缺陷？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾面临日益严重的固体废物管理挑战，需要评估RA 9003这一重要环境法律的实施成效和存在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策实施理论和环境管理框架，分析法律制度的有效性。
AI.method: 批判性分析法，通过评估RA 9003的法律条款、实施机制和实际效果进行分析。
AI.findings: RA 9003虽然具有参与性方法、制度深度和环境经济效益潜力等优势，但存在资金不足、执法薄弱、基础设施有限和公众意识低下等关键缺陷，导致合规性不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境政策实施研究提供了发展中国家环境法律执行困境的实证案例，丰富了政策执行理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了增加资金投入、强化执法机制、推动公私合作和开展全面教育等具体改进建议，为菲律宾固体废物管理政策优化提供实践指导。

title: Gendered Impacts of Oil Price Shocks: Analyzing Women's Labor Force Participation in Petrostates

detail.title: Gendered Impacts of Oil Price Shocks: Analyzing Women's Labor Force Participation in Petrostates
detail.abstract: Oil wealth has been shown to negatively affect women's participation in the labor force. But does declining revenue from fossil fuels, due to the global energy transition, lead to higher female labor force participation (FLFP) and greater gender equality in petrostates? Such hypothetical/future-oriented questions are difficult to answer. This study gets around the challenge by conducting a mixed-method analysis to assess the relationship between oil price shocks and FLFP, emphasizing socioeconomic development and policy implications. Empirical findings indicate there is a causal link between oil price shocks and FLFP in petrostates, with falling oil prices associated with increases in participation and rising prices linked to declines. This relationship appears to be driven by female employment opportunities, government transfers and subsidies, foreign worker flows, and governance quality. Qualitative evidence from Saudi Arabia demonstrates how policy reforms following the 2014 oil price bust can increase FLFP. The results suggest that petrostates are likely to encourage greater women's labor force participation to maintain their prosperity amid diminishing oil revenues driven by the energy transition and global decarbonization efforts in the coming decades.

AI.tldr: 石油价格冲击与石油国家女性劳动力参与率存在因果关系：油价下跌促进女性就业，油价上涨抑制女性参与。这一关系受就业机会、政府补贴、外籍劳工流动和治理质量影响。
AI.research_question: 全球化石燃料收入下降是否会导致石油国家女性劳动力参与率提高和性别平等改善？
AI.motivation: 石油财富已被证明对女性劳动力参与产生负面影响，但能源转型背景下石油收入下降的影响尚不清楚
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源诅咒理论、性别与劳动经济学、能源转型社会学
AI.method: 混合方法分析：实证分析油价冲击与女性劳动力参与率的关系，沙特案例定性研究
AI.findings: 油价下跌与女性劳动力参与率增加存在因果关系，油价上涨则导致参与率下降；主要驱动因素包括女性就业机会、政府转移支付、外籍劳工流动和治理质量
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了资源诅咒理论在性别维度的影响机制，建立了能源转型与性别平等的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油国家在能源转型背景下制定促进女性就业政策提供实证依据，沙特案例展示了政策改革如何提升女性劳动力参与

title: International Students, Immigration Policies and Implications for Innovation
affiliations: University of Massachusetts at Amherst - College of Social and Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics and Boston University School of Management

detail.title: International Students, Immigration Policies and Implications for Innovation
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the evolving trends and policy dynamics of international student migration, focusing on their implications for STEM workforce development and innovation. While the United States has remained a leading destination for international students, recent years have seen a plateau or decline in incoming students, contrasted by growth in countries like Canada, Australia, and emerging hubs such as China and India. International students, particularly in STEM fields, play a critical role in shaping host countries' innovation ecosystems, often transitioning to permanent residents and STEM workers. We review immigration policies, including post-graduation work and residency pathways, highlighting their varying impacts on student inflows and innovation. Policies in Canada and Australia have until recently eased these transitions, while restrictive measures in the U.S. and U.K. have posed challenges. By documenting these trends and policy shifts, we identify gaps in the literature and outline directions for future research at the intersection of international education, immigration, and innovation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际学生移民的趋势变化和政策动态，重点关注其对STEM劳动力发展和创新的影响。研究发现美国作为传统留学目的地吸引力下降，而加拿大、澳大利亚等国的政策优势促进了国际学生流入和人才保留。
AI.research_question: 国际学生移民趋势和政策变化如何影响STEM劳动力发展和创新生态系统？
AI.motivation: 国际学生特别是STEM领域学生在东道国创新生态系统中扮演关键角色，但各国移民政策差异导致学生流动格局发生变化，需要系统研究其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际人才流动理论、创新生态系统理论和移民政策分析框架
AI.method: 文献综述和政策分析，通过比较美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、英国、中国和印度等国的移民政策和学生流动数据
AI.findings: 美国国际学生数量增长停滞甚至下降，而加拿大和澳大利亚通过宽松的毕业后工作签证和移民政策吸引了更多STEM学生；限制性移民政策（如美英）阻碍了人才保留和创新贡献
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际人才流动与创新关系的理论理解，提出了政策环境对STEM人才保留和创新的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化国际学生移民政策的实证依据，帮助各国设计更有效的人才吸引和保留策略

title: Job Mismatch and Early Career Success
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and Princeton University

detail.title: Job Mismatch and Early Career Success
detail.abstract:
How does being over- or underqualified at the beginning of a worker's career affect skill acquisition, retention, and promotion? Despite the importance of mismatch for the labor market, self-selection into jobs has made estimating these effects difficult. We overcome endogeneity concerns in the context of the US Air Force, which allocates new enlistees to over 130 different jobs based, in part, on test scores. Using these test scores, we create simulated job assignments based on factors outside of an individual's control: the available slots in upcoming training programs and the quality of other recruits entering at the same time. These factors create quasi-random variation in job assignment and hence how cognitively demanding an individual's job is relative to their own ability. We find that being overqualified for a job causes higher attrition, both during technical training and afterward when individuals are working in their assigned jobs. It also results in more behavioral problems, worse performance evaluations, and lower scores on general knowledge tests about the military taken by all workers. On the other hand, overqualification results in better performance relative to others in the same job: job-specific test scores rise both during technical training and while on the job, and these individuals are more likely to be promoted. Combined, these patterns suggest that overqualified individuals are less motivated, but still outperform others in their same job. Underqualification results in a polar opposite set of findings, suggesting these individuals are motivated to put forth more effort, but still struggle to compete when judged relative to others. Consistent with differential incentives, individuals who are overqualified are in jobs which are less valuable in terms of outside earnings potential, while the reverse is true for those who are underqualified.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国空军新兵分配制度，研究了职业初期资质与岗位不匹配对技能获取、留任和晋升的影响。研究发现：资质过高导致更高离职率、更多行为问题，但在同岗位中表现更好且更易晋升；资质过低则相反，表明激励机制的差异影响。
AI.research_question: 职业初期资质与岗位不匹配如何影响技能获取、留任和晋升？
AI.motivation: 劳动力市场中资质不匹配现象普遍，但自我选择问题使得估计其影响存在困难，需要克服内生性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场匹配理论和激励理论，探讨资质不匹配对工作表现和职业发展的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用美国空军新兵分配制度，基于测试分数和训练名额等外生因素构建模拟工作分配，创造准随机变异来估计因果效应。
AI.findings: 资质过高导致更高离职率、更多行为问题、更差绩效评估，但在同岗位中表现更好且更易晋升；资质过低则呈现完全相反的模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资质不匹配的因果效应提供了实证证据，揭示了激励机制的调节作用，丰富了劳动力市场匹配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织人力资源管理提供启示，帮助理解不同资质匹配状况下员工的行为模式和绩效表现，有助于优化人员配置策略。

title: A Comparative Legal Analysis of Revenue Distribution Between the States
affiliations: Alliance University

detail.title: A Comparative Legal Analysis of Revenue Distribution Between the States
detail.abstract:
The Goods and Services Tax that was introduced in India in 2017 actually went on to enable a revolutionary shift in the indirect taxation regime in the nation by consolidating a chain of state and central taxes into one system. GST is a seminal reform in the tax regime of India, altering the very essence of the Centre-State relationship. This single tax system is intended to abolish  cascading taxation effects, in addition to maintaining free flows of goods and services betweenstate boundaries. In this connection, determining who receives how much with the introduction of GST has been a topic of much discussion; queries have been raised regarding revenues shared between the Centre and the States. The legal framework of the GST is dealt with in the paper. It critically examines its implications for Indian federalism in light of comparable tax systems in the
 other federations, particularly in Australia and Canada. Performance and implications of revenue sharing devices towards financial autonomy of states in the Indian federal system are also examined.

The major problems that arise through this analysis are less fiscal independence of States primarily owing to centralizing the administration via GST and the postponement in the payment of compensation generating tensions in Centre-State relationships. This paper visualizes reforms in India's GST regime in the directions of more balanced centralization and State autonomy, guided by an international approach. Finally, while GST has established India's economic integration,
long-term success requires additional steps to address the issues of the State governments and strengthen cooperative federalism.

AI.tldr: 印度GST税制改革统一了中央和地方税收，但导致各州财政自主权下降和中央与地方关系紧张，需要平衡集权与地方自治来加强合作联邦制
AI.research_question: 印度商品与服务税（GST）改革对中央与各州财政收入分配和联邦关系的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: GST作为印度税收制度的重大改革，改变了中央与各州的本质关系，需要研究其对各州财政自主权和联邦关系的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦制理论、财政联邦主义、税收制度改革理论
AI.method: 比较分析法（与澳大利亚和加拿大联邦税制比较）、法律框架分析、收入分配机制评估
AI.findings: GST导致各州财政独立性降低，中央集权化管理造成补偿支付延迟，加剧了中央与各州关系的紧张
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税收改革与联邦制关系理解，为财政联邦主义理论提供印度案例研究
AI.practical_contributions: 提出GST制度改革建议，促进更平衡的中央集权与地方自治，加强合作联邦制

title: Fractured Sovereignty: OECD Pillar Rules and Canada's Constitutional and Compliance Challenges in Global Tax Reform
affiliations: Ontario Institute for Studies in Education (OISE), University of Toronto

detail.title: Fractured Sovereignty: OECD Pillar Rules and Canada's Constitutional and Compliance Challenges in Global Tax Reform
detail.abstract: Canada’s dual-tax system and longstanding reliance on source-based principles place it in a uniquely precarious position under the OECD’s Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 frameworks. This paper offers a sovereignty-centered critique of the OECD’s evolving global tax order by analyzing the legal misalignments, enforcement burdens, and geopolitical ripple effects emerging from Canada's partial implementation of the two-pillar structure. Under Pillar 1, Canada’s decision to proceed with unilateral digital services taxation (DST), despite G7 pressure, has drawn direct retaliation threats from U.S. policymakers, including former President Donald Trump’s June 2025 campaign pronouncement to terminate bilateral tax negotiations. This reinforces that tax coordination is no longer technocratic—it is geopolitical. Under Pillar 2, Canada faces internal fragmentation. Federal authority to implement a global minimum tax sits uneasily with provincial autonomy over corporate income tax. Meanwhile, Canada’s longstanding FAPI regime, thin capitalization rules, and interest deductibility limits under sections 18.2 and 212.3 raise deep questions about how Pillar 2’s jurisdictional blending and GloBE top-up calculations will interact with pre-existing anti-deferral strategies. The paper argues that the OECD’s model glosses over such domestic legal pluralism, treating Canada as a unitary actor despite real administrative and political divergence. Without reconciling these internal and external sovereignty risks, Canada’s alignment with the two-pillar framework will remain partial, contentious, and potentially destabilizing.

AI.tldr: 加拿大在OECD双支柱框架下面临独特的税收主权挑战，包括Pillar 1下美国报复威胁和Pillar 2下联邦与省级税收权力冲突，现有国内反递延规则与全球最低税制存在协调难题。
AI.research_question: 加拿大在OECD双支柱税收框架下面临哪些主权风险和法律协调挑战？
AI.motivation: 加拿大双重税收体系和长期依赖来源地原则使其在OECD全球税收新秩序中处于独特脆弱地位，需要分析其部分实施双支柱框架带来的法律错位、执行负担和地缘政治影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权理论、税收协调理论、法律多元主义理论
AI.method: 法律分析和政策分析，考察加拿大国内税收制度与OECD框架的法律错位和协调问题
AI.findings: Pillar 1方面加拿大单边数字服务税引发美国报复威胁；Pillar 2方面联邦与省级税收权力冲突，现有FAPI制度、资本弱化规则等与全球最低税制存在协调难题
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了主权视角下的税收协调分析框架，揭示了OECD模式忽视国内法律多元主义的问题
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大政策制定者提供了应对双支柱框架的实施建议，指出了需要协调的内外部主权风险

title: Follow the carbon money: How capital market pricing of carbon risk shapes green transition of Chinese listed companies?
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE)

detail.title: Follow the carbon money: How capital market pricing of carbon risk shapes green transition of Chinese listed companies?
detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between corporate carbon risk exposure and green transition using a comprehensive sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2001 to 2023. We develop a new carbon risk exposure metric that circumvents reliance on corporate carbon emissions disclosures, thereby capturing both observable and latent carbon risks. Our analysis reveals a robust positive association between carbon risk exposure and subsequent green transition initiatives, suggesting that companies facing heightened carbon risk perceptions are more likely to adopt sustainability-oriented strategies. Mechanism analysis shows that financial constraints as a key mechanism driving this relationship. Companies with greater carbon risk exposure experience tighter financing conditions, which in turn motivates green transition efforts. Heterogeneity analysis further demonstrates that this effect is particularly salient for companies operating in regions with stronger environmental consciousness, where external pressures from local governments and the public amplify the linkage between carbon risk and green transition. Moreover, internal pressure arising from shareholders’ environmental concerns also accelerates the pace of corporate green transition. These findings contribute to the growing body of literature on the impacts of carbon risk and the drivers of green transition. Importantly, they highlight the role of financial markets as a catalyst for sustainable behavior of listed companies, particularly when investor perceptions of climate-related risks are factored into strategic decision-making processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了新的碳风险暴露度量指标，发现碳风险暴露与绿色转型呈正相关关系，财务约束是关键机制，且在环境意识强的地区和股东环保压力大的企业中效应更显著
AI.research_question: 企业碳风险暴露与绿色转型之间存在什么关系？财务约束在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有研究依赖企业碳排放披露数据，无法捕捉潜在碳风险，需要开发新的度量指标来全面评估碳风险对企业绿色转型的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论和资源约束理论，探讨碳风险感知如何通过融资约束机制影响企业绿色转型决策
AI.method: 使用2001-2023年中国A股上市公司数据，开发新的碳风险暴露度量指标，采用面板数据回归分析
AI.findings: 碳风险暴露与绿色转型呈显著正相关；财务约束是重要机制；环境意识强的地区和股东环保压力大的企业效应更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的碳风险度量方法，揭示了财务约束作为关键机制的作用，丰富了碳风险与绿色转型关系的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了评估企业碳风险的新工具，强调了金融市场在推动企业可持续发展中的催化作用

title: The Hidden Costs of Subsidized Housing in Bogotá: Rent vs. Buy, Liquidity, and the False Promise of VIS/VIP
affiliations: Temple University - Mathematics Department

detail.title: The Hidden Costs of Subsidized Housing in Bogotá: Rent vs. Buy, Liquidity, and the False Promise of VIS/VIP
detail.abstract: We assemble a twenty-year rent-versus-buy framework for Colombia's VIS/VIP housing and include the frictions that most policy summaries omit: gray-delivery finishing financed at consumer rates, uncovered down payment financed at consumer rates, HOA and maintenance creep, CPI-indexed commuting time, transaction and illiquidity costs, and early-sale clawbacks. Under realistic CPI-linked rents and flat-to-negative real appreciation, we find no scenario in which VIS ownership beats renting within 20 years. To our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive financial analysis comparing total ownership costs to renting for Colombia's VIS program, despite widespread anecdotal evidence of quality issues and subsidy failures.

AI.tldr: 哥伦比亚VIS/VIP住房项目20年租购比较分析显示，在考虑所有实际摩擦成本后，购房在任何情况下都不如租房划算
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚VIS/VIP住房项目中，购房与租房在20年时间框架内的财务成本比较如何？
AI.motivation: 现有政策总结往往忽略多种实际摩擦成本，导致对住房拥有成本的评估不准确，需要全面分析真实财务影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房金融理论、成本效益分析框架、摩擦成本理论
AI.method: 构建20年租购比较财务模型，纳入灰色交付装修成本、首付款融资成本、物业费和维护费增长、CPI指数化通勤时间成本、交易和流动性成本、提前出售回收条款等摩擦因素
AI.findings: 在现实的CPI挂钩租金和持平至负的实际升值情况下，VIS住房拥有在20年内没有任何情况下优于租房
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为哥伦比亚VIS项目提供全面的财务分析框架，系统识别和量化了被忽视的摩擦成本
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，揭示VIS项目补贴失效和质量问题的财务根源，建议重新评估住房政策有效性

title: Monte Carlo Simulation - How to Simulate Asset Prices for Derivatives Pricing (Presentation Slides)
affiliations: University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: Monte Carlo Simulation - How to Simulate Asset Prices for Derivatives Pricing (Presentation Slides)
detail.abstract: This presentation provides a comprehensive introduction to Monte Carlo simulation for derivative pricing, with a focus on equity options. In Part 1, we review the theoretical foundations, covering stochastic asset price modelling using Geometric Brownian Motion, Ito’s Lemma, Girsanov’s Theorem, Change of Measure, Risk-Neutral Valuation, and the role of martingales and arbitrage in modern asset pricing theory. In Part 2, we apply these concepts in practice by implementing a Monte Carlo framework to price vanilla and exotic options. We first validate the methodology by benchmarking against closed-form Black–Scholes values for European options, before extending the framework to exotic derivatives and double barrier knock-out options. We further illustrate how simulations can be used to compute quantities such as exercise probabilities and knock-out probabilities, providing practical insights into structuring and optimizing exotic products in line with client-specific risk–return profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文全面介绍了用于衍生品定价的蒙特卡洛模拟方法，重点讨论股票期权。第一部分回顾理论基础，包括几何布朗运动、伊藤引理、Girsanov定理等随机资产价格建模理论；第二部分实践应用蒙特卡洛框架定价普通和奇异期权，并通过与Black-Scholes闭式解对比验证方法有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效应用蒙特卡洛模拟方法进行股权衍生品定价，特别是对奇异期权的定价和风险分析？
AI.motivation: 随着金融市场复杂度的增加，传统定价方法难以处理奇异衍生品，需要发展基于模拟的定价技术来满足实际交易和风险管理需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机过程理论（几何布朗运动）、伊藤微积分、测度变换理论（Girsanov定理）、风险中性定价原理和无套利定价理论。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟方法，通过随机路径生成和统计估计进行衍生品定价，包括普通欧式期权和奇异障碍期权的定价验证。
AI.findings: 蒙特卡洛方法能够有效定价复杂衍生品，与Black-Scholes模型结果一致，并可计算执行概率、敲出概率等风险指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了随机过程理论、风险中性定价和蒙特卡洛方法，为复杂衍生品定价提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实施的蒙特卡洛定价框架，能够处理客户特定风险收益需求的奇异产品结构设计和优化。

title: Evaluating the Value of China’s South-South Cooperation in the Energy and Climate Space with a Focus on Decarbonization and Sustainable Development under Paris Agreement Commitments
affiliations: Pace University - School of Law

detail.title: Evaluating the Value of China’s South-South Cooperation in the Energy and Climate Space with a Focus on Decarbonization and Sustainable Development under Paris Agreement Commitments
detail.abstract: China's South-South Cooperation (SSC) in energy and climate sectors plays a vital role in shaping global decarbonization efforts. This paper assesses the impact of Chinese overseas investments, especially in Indonesia and Africa, within the framework of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) and Paris Agreement commitments. Despite China's promise to peak carbon emissions before 2030 and reach net-zero by 2060, its substantial financing of coal-fired power plants and mineral extraction projects continues to tie developing countries to carbonintensive growth. Through case studies from Indonesia's coal and nickel industries and Africa's energy infrastructure, the research reveals the dual nature of China's role-supporting energy access on one hand, but also causing ecological damage, air and water pollution, displacement, and health risks on the other. The findings indicate that although China has begun investing in renewable projects like hydropower and solar energy, these efforts remain limited compared to fossil fuel investments. Ultimately, the paper argues that China's current investment approach undermines its SSC principles and Paris commitments, emphasizing the need for a fundamental shift toward sustainable financing and genuine renewable energy collaboration to meet global climate goals.

AI.tldr: 中国在南南合作中的能源投资存在矛盾：一方面支持发展中国家能源获取，另一方面通过煤炭和矿产投资延续碳密集型发展，与其气候承诺相悖，需要转向可持续融资。
AI.research_question: 中国在南南合作框架下的能源与气候投资对全球脱碳努力的影响是什么？特别是在印尼和非洲的投资如何影响当地发展和全球气候目标？
AI.motivation: 评估中国在"一带一路"倡议和巴黎协定承诺框架下的海外投资实践，特别是考察其在支持发展中国家能源获取的同时是否促进了碳密集型发展模式，这与中国的气候承诺存在潜在矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 南南合作理论、全球气候治理框架、可持续发展理论、"一带一路"倡议的地缘经济理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，重点分析印尼的煤炭和镍产业以及非洲的能源基础设施项目
AI.findings: 1) 中国海外投资存在双重性：支持能源获取但造成生态破坏和污染；2) 可再生能源投资有限，化石燃料投资仍占主导；3) 当前投资模式与南南合作原则和巴黎承诺相冲突
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对南南合作在气候治理中矛盾性的理论理解，提出了"可持续南南合作"的理论框架，丰富了全球气候治理中新兴经济体角色的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国政府和企业提供了投资转型的政策建议，为发展中国家提供了与中国合作时确保可持续发展的实践指南，为全球气候治理提供了南南合作模式改革的实际操作路径

title: The Shape of U - On the Structure  of Utility \\ from Electric Vehicle Charging
affiliations: University of Cologne

detail.title: The Shape of U - On the Structure  of Utility \\ from Electric Vehicle Charging
detail.abstract: With the growing adoption of electric vehicles, understanding user charging behavior is increasingly important for informing operational, investment, and policy decisions regarding their integration into the power system.  While utility functions are commonly used to describe user preferences in charging behavior models, most existing studies rely on formulations with limited theoretical consistency and empirical validation, potentially leading to biased expectations. This paper empirically compares different utility function specifications and examines their implications for charging behavior modeling and charging station profitability. I introduce a novel discrete choice model framework to efficiently estimate utility function parameters from revealed preference data. Using a dataset of observed charging sessions at public charging stations in Germany, the model identifies accurate utility functions, uncovers charging preferences, and simulates station segment viability. The results suggest that charging utility is non-linear: marginal utility decreases with charged energy and marginal disutility increases with charging duration. An interaction between energy and duration leads to higher marginal valuation of energy for longer charging durations.  Stations profit from inelastic demand driven by users who highly value energy content, are less price sensitive, and engage in high-value activities at the charging location, such as in urban areas or traffic hubs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证比较不同效用函数规格，开发了一个新颖的离散选择模型框架来分析电动汽车用户充电行为，发现充电效用具有非线性特征，边际效用随充电量递减，边际负效用随充电时间递增。
AI.research_question: 不同效用函数规格如何影响电动汽车充电行为建模和充电站盈利性分析？
AI.motivation: 随着电动汽车普及，理解用户充电行为对电力系统运营、投资和政策决策至关重要，但现有研究中的效用函数缺乏理论一致性和实证验证，可能导致偏差预期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择理论和效用最大化理论，构建用户充电行为的选择模型框架。
AI.method: 引入新颖的离散选择模型框架，利用德国公共充电站的实际充电会话数据进行显示偏好数据参数估计。
AI.findings: 充电效用呈非线性：边际效用随充电能量递减，边际负效用随充电时长递增；能量与时长交互作用导致较长充电时长下能量边际估值更高；充电站从需求缺乏弹性的用户中获利，这些用户高度重视能量内容、价格敏感度较低，并在充电地点从事高价值活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个理论一致的效用函数框架，实证验证了充电行为的非线性效用特征，丰富了离散选择理论在充电行为建模中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为充电站运营商提供投资和定价策略指导，帮助政策制定者更好地规划充电基础设施，提高充电站盈利性和运营效率。

reference: The Journal of African American History, volume 106, issue 4, 2021[10.1086/716492]
title: From Nkrumah's Black Star to the African Diaspora: Ghanaian Intellectual Activists and the Development of Black Studies in the Americas
affiliations: Northwestern University

detail.title: From Nkrumah's Black Star to the African Diaspora: Ghanaian Intellectual Activists and the Development of Black Studies in the Americas

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Journal of African American History, volume 106, issue 4, 2021[10.1086/716492]

detail.abstract: After Kwame Nkrumah’s overthrow in 1966, a group of Ghanaian intellectuals brought their specific version of Pan-Africanism into the United States at precisely the moment when Black studies programs were being formed. Consequently, they shaped the trajectory of the field and linked it to a specifically African intellectual project. These Ghanaian intellectuals sought to inject an Africa-centered sense of what political education and political mobilization meant into the framework of Black studies. At the University of Massachusetts Amherst and Brown University, they worked to make Europe’s ongoing economic exploitation of Africa, the persistence of white supremacist regimes in southern Africa, and the US government’s support of these oppressive forces key parts of the otherwise US-centric curricula of Black studies programs. The role that Ghanaian intellectuals played in the United States helps us illuminate the unexplored intellectual impact of African scholars in the 1970s and 1980s outside of Africa on Black internationalism.

AI.tldr: 加纳知识分子在1966年恩克鲁玛政权被推翻后，将特定的泛非主义思想引入美国黑人研究领域，塑造了该领域的轨迹并将其与非洲知识项目联系起来。
AI.research_question: 加纳知识分子如何影响美国黑人研究项目的发展轨迹，并将其与非洲知识项目联系起来？
AI.motivation: 探索非洲学者在1970-1980年代对美国黑人国际主义思想的未充分研究的知识影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泛非主义、黑人国际主义、后殖民理论、知识转移理论
AI.method: 历史分析，重点关注加纳知识分子在马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校和布朗大学的活动
AI.findings: 加纳知识分子成功将非洲中心的政治教育和动员理念注入黑人研究课程，重点关注欧洲对非洲的经济剥削、南部非洲白人至上主义政权以及美国政府对压迫力量的支持
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非洲学者在非洲以外地区对黑人国际主义思想的重要知识影响，丰富了跨大西洋知识交流的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代黑人研究和非洲研究项目的课程设计提供了历史借鉴，强调了全球视角在种族研究中的重要性

title: Modelling and analysis of multi-timescale uncertainty in energy system planning
affiliations: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) - Department of Industrial Economics and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

detail.title: Modelling and analysis of multi-timescale uncertainty in energy system planning
detail.abstract: Recent developments in decomposition methods for multi-stage stochastic programming with block separable recourse enable the solution to large-scale stochastic programs with multi-timescale uncertainty. Multi-timescale uncertainty is important in energy system planning problems. Therefore, the proposed algorithms were applied to energy system planning problems to demonstrate their performance. However, the impact of multi-timescale uncertainty on energy system planning is not sufficiently analysed. In this paper, we address this research gap by comprehensively modelling and analysing short-term and long-term uncertainty in energy system planning. We use the REORIENT model to conduct the analysis. We also propose a parallel stabilised Benders decomposition as an alternative solution method to existing methods. We analyse the multi-timescale uncertainty regarding stability, the value of the stochastic solution, the rolling horizon value of the stochastic solutions and the planning decisions. The results show that (1) including multi-timescale uncertainty yields an increase in the value of the stochastic solutions, (2) long-term uncertainty in the right-hand side parameters affects the solution structure more than cost coefficient uncertainty, (3) parallel stabilised Benders decomposition is up to 7.5 times faster than the serial version.

AI.tldr: 本文通过REORIENT模型分析能源系统规划中的多时间尺度不确定性，提出了并行稳定Benders分解方法，发现多时间尺度不确定性增加了随机解的价值，且右侧参数的不确定性比成本系数不确定性对解结构影响更大。
AI.research_question: 多时间尺度不确定性对能源系统规划的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽然将多阶段随机规划分解方法应用于能源系统规划，但对多时间尺度不确定性的影响分析不足，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多阶段随机规划理论，块可分追索模型，Benders分解算法
AI.method: 使用REORIENT模型进行建模分析，提出并行稳定Benders分解方法作为替代解决方案
AI.findings: 1) 包含多时间尺度不确定性增加了随机解的价值；2) 右侧参数的长时期不确定性比成本系数不确定性对解结构影响更大；3) 并行稳定Benders分解比串行版本快7.5倍
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了并行稳定Benders分解算法，完善了多时间尺度不确定性建模理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源系统规划提供了更高效的求解方法，揭示了不同不确定性参数对规划决策的影响规律

title: The Home Stretch: County-Level Policy Implementation and Regional Financial Development in China
affiliations: Fudan University - School of Economics, Fudan University - School of Economics, Fudan University and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Finance

detail.title: The Home Stretch: County-Level Policy Implementation and Regional Financial Development in China
detail.abstract: Hierarchical structures, where central authorities delegate powers to local governments, are ubiquitous but face implementation challenges resulting from weak accountability. This study presents one of the first evidence of how local officials’ policy implementation affects regional financial development in China—a deeply hierarchical polity with a historical struggle to bridge the “last mile” of policy execution. We develop a new index of county-level Central Financial Policy Implementation Index (CFPI) based on over 6.32 million news releases of county governments on their websites between 2009 and 2023. We find that stronger CFPI implementation is positively associated with local loan innovation, a proxy for financial development. We further document that these effects are more substantial for counties where the officials have a finance-related background and stronger promotion incentives. Our paper highlights the importance of addressing the “last mile” issue in policy implementation in a decentralized administrative system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建县级中央金融政策执行指数(CFPI)，发现政策执行力度与地方金融发展正相关，特别是在官员具有金融背景和强晋升激励的地区效果更显著
AI.research_question: 地方官员政策执行如何影响区域金融发展？
AI.motivation: 层级制结构中普遍存在政策执行"最后一公里"问题，中国作为深度层级制政体面临政策执行挑战
AI.theoretical_framework: 层级制理论、政策执行理论、委托代理理论
AI.method: 基于2009-2023年632万条县级政府网站新闻发布构建CFPI指数，分析政策执行与金融发展的关系
AI.findings: 更强的CFPI执行与地方贷款创新(金融发展代理变量)正相关；在官员有金融背景和强晋升激励的县效果更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 为层级制政策执行理论提供实证证据，深化对"最后一公里"问题的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 强调在分权行政体系中解决政策执行"最后一公里"问题的重要性，为提升政策执行效果提供参考

title: Sustainable Development Goals and Land Tenure Security in Uganda
affiliations: Makerere University

detail.title: Sustainable Development Goals and Land Tenure Security in Uganda
detail.abstract: Land tenure security is important for achieving a number Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The purpose of this paper was to investigate variation in land tenure security across three districts located in different geographical regions of Uganda. Using a quantitative cross-sectional survey data collected in early 2019. The findings show that Kanungu district found in SouthWestern Uganda had significantly higher levels of land tenure security as compared to Nakasongola (Central) and Nwoya (Northern). Research findings have implications on further study and benchmarking land governance systems in Kanungu. Furthermore, they have implications on implementation of government and donor land titling or registration programs in terms of priority areas. They further sheds light on the importance of accounting for geographical context in land tenure studies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了乌干达三个不同地理区域地区的土地权属安全差异，发现西南部的Kanungu地区土地权属安全水平显著高于中部和北部地区
AI.research_question: 乌干达不同地理区域的三个地区在土地权属安全方面存在怎样的差异？
AI.motivation: 土地权属安全对实现多个可持续发展目标（SDGs）具有重要意义，需要了解不同地区的差异情况
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于土地权属安全和土地治理理论框架
AI.method: 采用定量横断面调查方法，数据收集于2019年初
AI.findings: 位于乌干达西南部的Kanungu地区土地权属安全水平显著高于中部的Nakasongola和北部的Nwoya地区
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了地理背景在土地权属研究中的重要性，为土地治理理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和捐助者的土地确权或登记项目的优先区域选择提供指导，为Kanungu地区的土地治理系统提供了可借鉴的基准

title: Public R&D Meets Economic Development: Embrapa and Brazil’s Agricultural Revolution
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Notre Dame University and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Public R&D Meets Economic Development: Embrapa and Brazil’s Agricultural Revolution
detail.abstract:
Can public R&D investment in developing countries drive productivity growth? We study this question in the context of Brazilian agriculture and the Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa Agropecuária (Embrapa), a public research corporation established in 1973 to develop locally suitable science and technology. First, we show that Embrapa redirected research toward prioritized staple crops and local ecological conditions, and increased research productivity, especially in remote and research-scarce regions. Second, exploiting the staggered rollout of research centers alongside heterogeneous local exposure to Embrapa’s technology development, we find that Embrapa significantly increased agricultural output, driven both by higher productivity and expanded input use. Combined with a model, these estimates imply that public R&D investment increased national agricultural productivity by 110% with a benefit-cost ratio of 17. The decentralized structure, in which research labs were spread across many ecological zones instead of in a single hub, explains a large share of these benefits.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Shield and Trap: Crop Insurance and the Adaptation Paradox
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington and Lincoln University

detail.title: Shield and Trap: Crop Insurance and the Adaptation Paradox
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the paradoxical role of crop insurance in shaping farmers’ responses to climate risk. Using a newly constructed county–crop–year panel dataset covering 1,686 U.S. counties from 1989 to 2023, we combine agricultural production data, PRISM climate records, EM-DAT disaster exposure, and USDA Risk Management Agency insurance data. We propose the concept of Insurance-Induced Adaptive Inertia (IAII) and formalize the Insurance Paradox Proposition: while crop insurance reduces short-run risk exposure through income stabilization, it simultaneously weakens long-run adaptive responses by locking farmers into maladaptive production structures.Empirically, our baseline fixed-effects models show that indemnity payments significantly stabilize crop shares, confirming the short-run buffering effect. However, the interaction of insurance variables with temperature and the IAII index reveals a systematic reduction in climate sensitivity, consistent with maladaptation. Robustness checks—including placebo tests, alternative insurance measures, and event-study designs—further support this finding. Moreover, policy heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that the 1994 Federal Crop Insurance Reform Act and the 2000 Agricultural Risk Protection Act amplified the paradox, as expanded subsidies deepened farmers’ adaptive inertia.Our results highlight an Insurance Paradox: crop insurance functions as both a shield and a trap—protecting farmers in the short run but eroding their long-run adaptive capacity. This challenges the conventional view that insurance unambiguously promotes adaptation and calls for policy designs that integrate resilience criteria into insurance programs.

title: Transdisciplinary Equilibrium (JX): in Dating Apps From Emotional Divergence to Recognition-Seeking Business / Anticipatory Suppression and Social Cost in Dating Platforms: A JX Framework Whitepaper

detail.title: Transdisciplinary Equilibrium (JX): in Dating Apps From Emotional Divergence to Recognition-Seeking Business / Anticipatory Suppression and Social Cost in Dating Platforms: A JX Framework Whitepaper
detail.abstract: This paper applies the Transdisciplinary Equilibrium (JX) framework to dating apps. Rather than neutral marketplaces for matching, platforms sustain recognition-seeking equilibria where emotional divergence (E), structural asymmetry (S), and anticipatory suppression (A) interact through a social cost function J(x) = αE(x) + βS(x) + γA(x) with α, β, γ ≥ 0 and α + β + γ = 1. We reconstruct common app experiences into schematic figures and dialogues (no screenshots), formalize threshold participation and interaction effects, and propose measurement, estimation, and design levers.

title: Open government data and corporate investment:Evidence from Chinese A-share Listed Companies
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Central University of Finance and Economics, Zhejiang University and Tianjin University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Open government data and corporate investment:Evidence from Chinese A-share Listed Companies
detail.abstract: The governmental governance environment significantly influences real corporate investment. Based on the data of listed A-share enterprises from 2010-2020,we adopt a heterogeneous timing difference-in-differences method to examine the impact of Open government data (OGD) on real corporate investment by leveraging the launch of OGD platforms. It is found that OGD significantly promotes real corporate investment. This conclusion remains robust after a series of tests for robustness and endogeneity, including parallel trend, placebo, heterogeneity treatment effect, and replacing variable. The analysis of the impact mechanism reveals that OGD influences real corporate investment by reducing enterprise uncertainty and alleviating financing constraint. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that OGD exerts a more pronounced investment promotion effect on non-state-owned enterprises, without political affiliations, regions characterized by intense government intervention, and areas exhibiting low social trust. This study contributes both conceptual insights for advancing the real economy with higher quality and practical recommendations to support the modernization of national governance structures and administrative effectiveness.

title: From the Arab Oil Embargo to Rare Earths: How Reactive Leadership Endangers U.S. National Security
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: From the Arab Oil Embargo to Rare Earths: How Reactive Leadership Endangers U.S. National Security
detail.abstract: This paper examines the enduring consequences of reactive leadership on U.S. national security by drawing a parallel between the 1973 Arab oil embargo and the current crisis surrounding rare earth elements. Both episodes expose a dangerous pattern: the United States often fails to anticipate resource-based geopolitical threats until they escalate into full-blown crises. Despite the strategic warning embedded in the oil shock of the 1970s, the U.S. remains heavily dependent on foreign sources, now for rare earth minerals critical to advanced technologies and military systems. The paper argues that this failure to apply historical lessons has left national defense and technological capabilities vulnerable to external disruption, particularly from countries that dominate the global rare earth supply chain. Through historical analysis and contemporary policy critique, this work calls for a shift from reactive to proactive leadership grounded in strategic foresight. Securing access to critical resources must be treated not merely as an economic goal, but as a national security imperative.

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We analyse the consequences of carbon price heterogeneity on households in The EU from 2010 to 2020. Accounting for both heterogeneity in carbon pricing across emission sources and the indirect effects from inter-industry linkages, we obtain two key findings. First, due to widespread carbon pricing exemptions, household burdens are lower than previously estimated. Second, lower-income groups are affected disproportionately, because they spend a smaller share of their expenditure on products that benefit from exemptions than their higher-income counterparts. Therefore, imposing uniform carbon prices both within and across countries would reduce carbon pricing regressivity on household expenditure in the EU. A global price would be most effective in this regard, as it would raise carbon prices embodied in EU imports. Further, because EU economies are open and apply higher average carbon prices than their trade partners, the domestic revenues exceed the costs embodied in EU household consumptions bundles. This increases the scope for reducing the burden of carbon pricing on lower-income households through revenue redistribution. Our results imply that the ongoing extension of carbon pricing to more sectors through the EU ETS II and the introduction of the EU's CBAM should make carbon pricing less regressive, all else equal.

detail.title: A Web-Based Platform Bridging the Gap Between Contractors and Customers in the Construction Industry
detail.abstract: The construction industry often grapples with issues related to trust, transparency, and accessibility-especially for individual customers and small contractors. Mirror Constr is a final year project designed to address these challenges through a digital platform that acts as a transparent mediator between customers and contractors. This research paper explores the platform's structure, features, and its potential to democratize the construction domain. By enabling contractors to showcase their work and ratings and allowing customers to float tenders, the platform brings balance and accessibility to an otherwise monopolized space. The study also focuses on how new civil engineers can benefit from easier market entry and more visibility. This paper presents an in-depth review of related works, discusses the relevance and scope of the study, outlines the research methodology, and concludes with findings that validate the platform's utility and innovation.

title: International Organizations as Actors in International Relations: Assessment of Effectiveness and Development Prospects
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: International Organizations as Actors in International Relations: Assessment of Effectiveness and Development Prospects
detail.abstract:
This paper analyzes the scope and prospects of international bodies with a particular focus on the role of the United Nations in contemporary global governance. With the ongoing rise of a multipolar world and the complex transnational issues of climate change, pandemics, and terrorism, the UN's traditional post-World War II configuration is increasingly under fire. This research addresses the urgent need reform the UN because of the of the surging perception that the UN is dysfunctional and its failure to cope with modern crises. 

This inquiry is approached through the three major theoretical paradigms of international relations: liberalism, neorealism, and constructivism. This paper uses these frameworks to explore the dominant challenges and opportunities for change of such institutional inertia. It discusses some specific changes such as the extension of the Security Council and the amendment of the General Assembly's voting procedures, stressing especially the absence of a decisive political will from the major powers. 

The findings reveal that for the United Nations to retain its relevance and functionality, the revamped structure must be underpinned by a significant change in the interplay of functionality and legitimacy. This is to emphasize that the reform of the UN must be approached in a balanced manner between the interests of the powerful states and the international community as a whole in order for the United Nations to provide an adequate response as a forum for the fundamental issues of the 21st century.

title: Applied Behavioral Tokenomics: A New Paradigm for Incentivized Human Action
affiliations: Independent, Independent and Independent

detail.title: Applied Behavioral Tokenomics: A New Paradigm for Incentivized Human Action
detail.abstract: In this paper, we introduce the term Applied Behavioral Tokenomics (ABT), coined in Saratoga, California, on August 24, 2025. We define ABT as the design and deployment of token-based systems that can directly shape, reinforce, and measure human behavior in applied social contexts. Unlike previous existing work on "behavioral tokenomics," which focuses on how consumers perceive token design in financial markets, ABT emphasizes real-world behavioral outcomes in major aspects of human life, such as education, rehabilitation, and workforce development. Built on behavioral economics pioneered by Nobel laureate Richard Thaler, ABT recognizes that individuals are influenced not only by external and internal rational incentives but also by heuristics, emotions, and social context. Through tokens embedded into structured reinforcement systems, ABT anchors behaviors to explicit sponsor-backed rewards or repellents, creating measurable and adaptive economies of action. The core principles of ABT include behavioral anchoring, positive and negative reinforcement, programmatic structuring of milestones or goals, sponsor-backed redemption economies, and continuous data feedback loops. Through this lifecycle, ABT proposes a paradigm in which societies incentivize action that is incentive-based rather than punitive and restorative rather than exploitative, while also being measurable. Our early applied model is EdKoin by EdKoin Educational Systems, Inc., a platform for tokenized behavioral reinforcement in schools, rehabilitation, and correctional systems, etc. EdKoin demonstrates how, through ABT, we aim to reduce recidivism risk and reinforce pro-social behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了应用行为代币经济学（ABT）概念，这是一种通过代币系统在现实社会环境中直接塑造、强化和测量人类行为的设计方法，区别于传统金融市场的代币经济学，专注于教育、康复等生活领域的实际行为结果。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和部署基于代币的系统来直接塑造、强化和测量人类在现实社会情境中的行为？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于诺贝尔奖得主Richard Thaler的行为经济学理论，认为个体行为不仅受外部和内部理性激励影响，还受到启发式、情绪和社会情境的影响。
AI.method: 通过将代币嵌入结构化强化系统，建立行为锚定机制，采用正向和负向强化、程序化目标设定、赞助商支持的经济兑换系统以及持续数据反馈循环。
AI.findings: 提出了ABT的核心原则：行为锚定、正负强化、程序化目标结构、赞助商支持的经济兑换和持续数据反馈循环，并通过EdKoin平台展示了在教育和矫正系统中的应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了应用行为代币经济学的理论框架，将行为经济学原理扩展到代币化行为强化系统，提出了可测量和适应性行为经济的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了EdKoin实践平台，展示了ABT在减少再犯风险和强化亲社会行为方面的应用潜力，为教育、康复等社会领域提供了新的行为干预工具。

title: Pension Reform and Stock Market Development
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Pension Reform and Stock Market Development
detail.abstract: It is widely believed that deep domestic stock markets must be in place before introducing funded pension schemes. However, this view creates a “chicken-and-egg” dilemma: policymakers prefer to launch pension reforms only when well-functioning stock markets exist, yet such markets often depend on the presence of long-term, rational institutional investors, such as private pension funds. In this paper, we show that one way to break this dilemma is to implement fully-funded, individually-owned, collectively-managed, mandatory/incentivized (FICMI) pension schemes. Our cross-country empirical analysis and a stylized model suggest that FICMI pension schemes can activate a virtuous cycle: the development of FICMI pension schemes can support domestic stock market growth, improve capital allocation, and foster economic growth. This, in turn, attracts institutional investors like pension funds, which further reinforce domestic stock market development. In addition, we highlight how FICMI schemes can address coordination failures and network externalities that deter long-term equity investment. We also discuss enabling conditions and policy design for successful implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FICMI养老金方案可破解"先有发达股市还是先有养老金"的困境，通过实证和模型证明其能启动良性循环：促进股市发展、改善资本配置、推动经济增长，进而吸引更多机构投资者。
AI.research_question: 如何破解"先有发达股市还是先有养老金"的困境？FICMI养老金方案能否成为解决方案？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为必须先有发达的国内股票市场才能引入养老金计划，但这造成了"鸡生蛋还是蛋生鸡"的困境，阻碍了养老金改革和资本市场发展
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调失败理论、网络外部性理论、机构投资者理论
AI.method: 跨国实证分析和理论模型构建
AI.findings: FICMI养老金方案能够启动良性循环：促进国内股票市场发展、改善资本配置效率、推动经济增长，并吸引更多机构投资者
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了破解养老金与股市发展困境的新理论框架，揭示了FICMI方案的机制和作用路径
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的实施方案设计建议和成功实施的条件指导

title: Earnings Instability
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Chicago Booth School of Business, University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Chicago

detail.title: Earnings Instability
detail.abstract:
This paper uses high-frequency administrative data to show that the majority of U.S. workers experience substantial month-to-month fluctuations in pay, even within ongoing employment relationships. This earnings instability is pervasive, but it has been masked in past analysis of annual data. Moreover, this instability is unequally distributed: lower-income, hourly workers face more instability than higher-income, salaried workers. This is because earnings instability arises in large part from firm-driven fluctuations in hours. This earnings instability is a meaningful source of economic risk: we provide causal evidence that it increases consumption volatility and also leads to greater job separations, and we find that workers have a high willingness to pay to reduce earnings instability. These findings suggest that short-term earnings risk is a significant and previously underappreciated feature of the labor market.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国工人普遍存在月度收入波动，低收入时薪制工人面临更大收入不稳定性，这种不稳定性主要由企业驱动的工时波动造成，增加了消费波动和离职风险，工人愿意支付高价来减少收入不稳定性
AI.research_question: 美国工人月度收入波动的程度、分布特征及其经济影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 过去基于年度数据的分析掩盖了月度收入不稳定性问题，需要揭示这一被忽视的劳动市场特征
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学、收入风险理论、消费平滑理论
AI.method: 使用高频行政数据分析月度收入波动，提供因果证据
AI.findings: 大多数美国工人存在显著月度收入波动；低收入时薪制工人比高收入月薪制工人面临更大不稳定性；收入不稳定性主要由企业驱动的工时波动造成；增加消费波动和离职风险；工人愿意支付高价减少收入不稳定性
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了短期收入风险作为劳动市场重要但被低估的特征，丰富了收入风险理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于收入不稳定性的实证证据，有助于设计更好的收入保障政策

title: The Role of the Oil and Gas Sector in Shaping Trinidad and Tobago’s Economic Trajectory
affiliations: Fudan University

detail.title: The Role of the Oil and Gas Sector in Shaping Trinidad and Tobago’s Economic Trajectory
detail.abstract: The economy of Trinidad and Tobago has long been characterized by its reliance on the oil and gas sector, which has served as both the foundation of national prosperity and a source of structural vulnerability. This paper examines the central role of hydrocarbons in shaping the country's economic trajectory, highlighting how resource dependence has influenced patterns of growth, diversification, and long-term sustainability. Drawing on historical and contemporary data, the analysis situates Trinidad and Tobago within the broader framework of resource-based economies, engaging with theories of the "resource curse," Dutch disease, and economic rent distribution. The findings underscore the dual nature of the sector's impact. On one hand, oil and gas revenues have enabled Trinidad and Tobago to achieve relatively high levels of per capita income, finance extensive social programs, and maintain macroeconomic stability in comparison to many of its Caribbean neighbors. On the other hand, heavy dependence on hydrocarbons has hindered structural diversification, fostered exposure to volatile global energy markets, and created fiscal rigidities. These dynamics have contributed to cycles of boom and bust, with significant implications for employment, inequality, and public investment. The paper further considers the government's efforts to mitigate these challenges through policy interventions, such as the establishment of the Heritage and Stabilisation Fund, the promotion of downstream energy industries, and recent initiatives aimed at expanding non-energy sectors like tourism, financial services, and the creative industries. Despite these measures, the transition toward a more diversified and resilient economy remains incomplete, constrained by institutional, structural, and global market factors. Ultimately, the analysis demonstrates that while the oil and gas sector has defined the trajectory of Trinidad and Tobago's development, the sustainability of future growth depends on the country's capacity to leverage resource wealth into broader economic transformation.

AI.tldr: 特立尼达和多巴哥经济长期依赖油气行业，既是繁荣基础也是结构性脆弱源。论文分析油气在塑造经济轨迹中的核心作用，揭示资源依赖对增长模式、多元化和可持续性的双重影响，并评估政府应对措施的有效性。
AI.research_question: 油气行业如何塑造特立尼达和多巴哥的经济轨迹？资源依赖对经济增长、结构多元化和长期可持续性产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 特立尼达和多巴哥作为典型的资源依赖型经济体，其油气行业既是国家繁荣的基础，也是结构性脆弱性的来源，需要深入分析这种双重性对经济发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源诅咒理论、荷兰病理论、经济租金分配理论、资源型经济框架
AI.method: 基于历史和当代数据的分析，将特立尼达和多巴哥置于资源型经济体的更广泛框架中进行研究
AI.findings: 油气收入带来高人均收入、社会项目资助和宏观经济稳定，但阻碍结构多元化、加剧全球能源市场波动暴露、造成财政刚性，导致繁荣-萧条周期，影响就业、不平等和公共投资
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对资源依赖型经济体双重性的理解，为资源诅咒和荷兰病理论提供实证支持，丰富经济租金分配理论的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为特立尼达和多巴哥政府提供政策建议，包括遗产稳定基金的有效运用、下游能源产业发展和非能源部门多元化策略，对其他资源依赖型经济体具有借鉴意义

title: Working Paper -Cognitive Fallow in AI Labour Markets: A Global Framework with an Australian Evidence Snapshot
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Working Paper -Cognitive Fallow in AI Labour Markets: A Global Framework with an Australian Evidence Snapshot
detail.abstract: This paper introduces cognitive fallow as a cohort-level condition in which highly educated new entrants experience prolonged, involuntary under-utilisation because artificial intelligence (AI) has automated or reallocated the entry-level cognitive tasks that historically served as stepping stones into professional work. We situate the concept within task-based technological change, graduate overeducation, and search-and-matching literatures; formalise a simple mechanism that predicts fewer junior vacancies and higher experience thresholds; and propose a Cognitive Fallow Index (CFI) built from graduate outcomes and vacancy data. Using a historical snapshot of the Australian labour market (July 2025), we calculate a national 'CFI-lite' proxy to test for aggregate-level distress. The resulting null signal at this aggregate level demonstrates the masking effect of broad occupational categories and motivates the paper's primary contribution: a framework for granular, field-specific measurement required to detect hidden entry-level bottlenecks. We outline an identification strategy (event study and triple differences) and a policy programme-targeted hiring credits, apprenticeship-style AI fellowships, and skills-linked procurement-grounded in matching externalities and human-capital depreciation. The framework turns diffuse "AI job loss" debates into measurable, testable bottlenecks at labour-market entry and provides an evaluation-ready agenda for policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知休耕"概念，指高学历新人因AI自动化入门级认知任务而长期非自愿低就业状态，建立了测量框架和政策方案
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何通过自动化入门级认知任务影响高学历新人的就业机会和职业发展路径？
AI.motivation: AI技术自动化了传统上作为职业入门垫脚石的初级认知任务，导致高学历新人面临长期非自愿低就业问题，但现有研究缺乏细粒度测量框架
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务导向技术变革理论、毕业生过度教育理论以及搜寻匹配理论
AI.method: 构建认知休耕指数(CFI)，使用澳大利亚劳动力市场历史数据计算国家层面CFI-lite代理指标，提出事件研究和三重差分识别策略
AI.findings: 在总体层面未发现显著信号，表明宽泛的职业分类掩盖了问题，需要更细粒度的领域特异性测量来检测隐藏的入门级瓶颈
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了认知休耕的概念框架，将分散的"AI失业"辩论转化为可测量的劳动力市场入门瓶颈问题
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了针对性的政策方案（定向雇佣补贴、学徒式AI奖学金、技能关联采购），为政策制定者提供了可评估的行动议程

title: The Algorithm Advantage: Ranked Application Systems Outperform Decentralized and Common Applications in Boston and Beyond
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Kennedy School (HKS), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Algorithm Advantage: Ranked Application Systems Outperform Decentralized and Common Applications in Boston and Beyond
detail.abstract:
School choice systems increasingly use common applications, where students can apply to multiple schools on a single form, though schools make admission decisions independently. We model three application systems: a common application, a decentralized system with costly separate applications, and a ranked-choice system using a matching algorithm. Our model shows that while a common application may expand access, it increases competition and may produce worse matches than a decentralized system where application costs encourage more selective applications. Ranked-choice systems combine reduced application costs with preference-based matching that reduce mismatches. We examine these predictions by analyzing how Boston's charter school sector was affected when it adopted an online common application. Counterfactual simulations suggest the common application performs no better than alternatives on several metrics and did little to increase access for disadvantaged groups. A ranked system consistently outperforms a common application across various levels of competition and assumptions on preference stability between application and enrollment stages.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种学校申请系统：统一申请系统、分散申请系统和排名选择系统。研究发现统一申请系统虽然扩大了申请范围，但加剧了竞争并可能导致更差的匹配结果，而排名选择系统在减少申请成本的同时通过偏好匹配减少了错配。
AI.research_question: 不同学校申请系统（统一申请、分散申请、排名选择）如何影响学生入学机会和匹配质量？
AI.motivation: 随着学校选择系统越来越多地使用统一申请表，需要了解这种系统相对于传统分散申请和排名选择系统的效果差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学校选择理论和匹配理论，构建三种申请系统的理论模型进行比较分析。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析，使用波士顿特许学校部门采用在线统一申请的数据进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: 统一申请系统在多个指标上并不优于替代方案，对弱势群体的入学机会改善有限；排名系统在各种竞争水平和偏好稳定性假设下都优于统一申请系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了学校申请系统选择的理论框架，揭示了不同系统设计对学生匹配质量和入学机会的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者选择学校申请系统提供了实证依据，建议考虑采用排名选择系统来改善学生-学校匹配质量。

title: The Tax Redistribution Gap

detail.title: The Tax Redistribution Gap
detail.abstract: The tax revenue gap-the difference between how much the IRS collects in tax revenue and how much it should collect based on the text of the Internal Revenue Codeis both well-defined and well-studied. But raising revenue is just one purpose of taxation; the tax code also operates to redistribute wealth. Drawing from the tax revenue gap and redistribution literatures, this article coins a parallel concept, the tax redistribution gap, to map the extent to which the tax system falls short of its redistributive goals. Introducing a tax redistribution gap measure challenges background assumptions in current tax discourse: first, it would call out a reliance on pre-market income as a distributive baseline, which serves to overstate the redistributive impact of the tax code; second, it would increase the profile of redistribution among policymakers and the publicunderstandably, measures like the tax revenue gap and tax expenditure budgets focus dialogue on tax evasion and over-spending by the government. Ultimately, the tax redistribution gap would provide a single measure that displays how we are falling short of a key task of the state (redistribution). And by understanding and comparing the component ways our current tax systems falls short of it intended outcomes, we can better tailor redistributive policy solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"税收再分配缺口"概念，用于衡量税收系统在实现财富再分配目标方面的不足，挑战了当前税收讨论中对税前收入作为分配基线的依赖，并为制定更有效的再分配政策提供衡量工具。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量税收系统在实现财富再分配目标方面的表现不足？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注税收收入缺口（实际征收与应征收的差额），但忽视了税收的另一个重要目的——财富再分配。需要一个新的衡量标准来评估税收系统在再分配功能上的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合税收收入缺口文献和再分配文献，建立税收再分配缺口的理论框架，挑战以税前收入为分配基线的传统假设。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过理论推导提出税收再分配缺口的定义和衡量方法，并与税收收入缺口进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 税收再分配缺口能够揭示税收系统在实现再分配目标方面的不足，挑战了过度强调税收再分配效果的传统观点，并为政策制定提供新的视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了税收再分配缺口的新概念，丰富了税收理论和再分配理论，为评估税收系统的再分配功能提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公众提供了衡量税收再分配效果的单一指标，有助于更好地制定针对性的再分配政策解决方案，提高再分配问题在政策讨论中的重要性。

reference: Journal of Territorial and Maritime Studies / Volume 5, Number 1 / Winter/Spring 2018 / pp. 23–41
title: When Westphalia Goes to (Greater) China: Territory, Sovereignty and legal Narratives Across the Strait
affiliations: Amsterdam Center for International Law

detail.title: When Westphalia Goes to (Greater) China: Territory, Sovereignty and legal Narratives Across the Strait

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Territorial and Maritime Studies / Volume 5, Number 1 / Winter/Spring 2018 / pp. 23–41

detail.abstract:
The present study aims to reconceptualize the underlying tenets of Westphalian links between sovereignty and territoriality, showing how an "exported" eurocentric doctrine actually functions in a distinct legal environment-post-imperial China-and the manner in which a protracted political-ontological dispute can or cannot make use of established Western-based legal mechanisms. 

Approach-By focusing on the cross-strait dilemma of overlapping claims to sovereignty upon a "greater" China-advanced both by the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China (Taiwan)-we aim to show how volatile (and fragile) the functionality of Westphalia actually is. In this regard, we first concentrate upon the "genealogy" of Westphalia itself, as well as on the competing narrative of Sinocentric regional order, setting the scene for an unavoidable clash of paradigms. Afterwards, it is shown how the allegedly victorious vision of Westphalia was rewritten (and conceptually undermined) when applied to the cross-strait divergence. 

Findings-By following a genealogical path of Westphalia and of the intra-Sinic dispute, the present enquiry shows that a eurocentric concept (such as sovereignty) is ill-suited to address challenges that occur in such different legal-political frameworks. Moreover, it can be discerned that even though Westphalia could have been of some (albeit limited) use when european and non-european actors collided, it is unable to deliver a path forward for polities that were both part of a common non–Westphalian system.

Originality—When taken apart, neither the analysis of Westphalia, nor of the Sinocentric paradigm structurally reconfigure the shape of the present debates. However, it is a leap forward to join them together into a larger narrative about crosscultural collisions, showing how even a neutralized Westphalia is dysfunctional in polities with a distinct (and strong) political tradition.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新概念化威斯特伐利亚主权与领土性联系的基本原理，展示欧洲中心主义学说在后帝国中国法律环境中的实际运作方式，以及长期政治本体论争议如何利用西方法律机制。
AI.research_question: 欧洲中心主义的威斯特伐利亚主权概念在非西方法律政治框架（特别是后帝国中国环境）中的适用性和功能性如何？
AI.motivation: 探讨威斯特伐利亚体系在跨文化碰撞中的局限性，特别是在两岸主权争议这一独特案例中，揭示欧洲中心主义概念在不同法律政治框架中的不适应性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威斯特伐利亚主权理论、中华中心主义区域秩序理论、谱系学分析方法、政治本体论
AI.method: 谱系学路径分析，比较威斯特伐利亚体系与中华中心主义范式的历史发展和概念演变，聚焦两岸主权争议案例研究
AI.findings: 欧洲中心主义的主权概念不适合处理不同法律政治框架中的挑战；威斯特伐利亚体系在欧洲与非欧洲行为体碰撞时作用有限，在共同非威斯特伐利亚体系的政治体中无法提供前进路径
AI.theory_contributions: 将威斯特伐利亚分析与中华中心范式结合，构建跨文化碰撞的宏大叙事，揭示中性化威斯特伐利亚在具有独特政治传统政体中的功能失调
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解两岸主权争议提供新的理论视角，揭示国际法律概念在跨文化应用中的局限性，为类似地缘政治争议提供分析框架

title: Characterizing Optimality in Dynamic Settings: A Monotonicity-based Approach
affiliations: Harvard University, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Characterizing Optimality in Dynamic Settings: A Monotonicity-based Approach
detail.abstract:
We develop a novel analytical method for studying optimal paths in dynamic optimization problems under general monotonicity conditions. The method centers on a locator function—a simple object constructed directly from the model’s primitives—whose roots identify interior steady states and whose slope determines their local stability. Under strict concavity of the payoff function, the locator function also characterizes basins of attraction, yielding a complete description of qualitative dynamics. Without concavity, it can still deliver sharp results: if the function is single crossing from above, its root identifies a globally stable steady state; if the locator function is inverted-U-shaped with two interior roots (a typical case), only the higher root can be a locally stable interior steady state. The locator function further enables comparative statics of steady states with respect to parameters through direct analysis of its derivatives. These results are obtained without solving the full dynamic program. We illustrate the approach using a generalized neoclassical growth model, a rational (un)fitness model, and a learning-by-doing economy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种分析动态优化问题中最优路径的新方法，通过构建定位函数直接识别稳态点及其稳定性，无需求解完整的动态规划问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在一般单调性条件下研究动态优化问题中的最优路径和稳态特性？
AI.motivation: 传统动态规划方法求解复杂且计算量大，需要一种更简单直接的分析方法来研究动态优化问题的定性动态特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于单调性条件和严格凹性的动态优化理论，构建定位函数作为核心分析工具。
AI.method: 开发定位函数方法，直接从模型原语构造简单对象，通过分析其根和斜率来识别稳态点和稳定性。
AI.findings: 定位函数的根识别内部稳态点，斜率决定局部稳定性；在严格凹性下可完整描述吸引域；非凹性条件下仍能获得精确结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于定位函数的动态优化分析新框架，简化了稳态分析和比较静态分析的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法可应用于新古典增长模型、理性（不）适应模型和干中学经济等多种经济模型，为实际政策分析提供工具。

detail.title: An Analysis of Elasticity and Returns To Scale of Paddy Production in Telangana State- a Special Reference to the Warangal District (शिक्षण आशण समाज

keywords: Cultivators and Cobb Douglas Production Function

publicationDetails.detailsText: Education and Society (शिक्षण आशण समाज) Vol-47, Issue-1, No.-14, January-March: 2023

detail.abstract: As far back as Independence, agriculture has contributed a significant amount to the development of the economy. During the financial year 1950-1951, agriculture accounted for 59% of the country's total GDP. While the agriculture sector has been declining, (17.8% of the GDP for the year 2019-20), it still plays an important role in the Indian economy and 54.6% of the total workforce is engaged in agricultural and allied sector activities (Census 2011) and accounts for Given the importance of the agriculture sector, the Government of India has taken several steps for its development in a sustainable manner. Steps have been taken to improve the income of farmers. The present paper seeks to understand paddy crop production elasticity and returns to scale in the Warangal District in Telangana State. Paddy crop is grown both in the kharif and rabi seasons in the country. As for the agricultural ministry's advanced estimates for the Kharif session of 2022-23, India's Paddy production is likely to decline by 6% to 104.99 million tonnes in the Kharif session. Paddy cultivation in Telangana hit a new high this Yasangi crop season with the crop sown in nearly 54 lakh acres, a staggering increase of 160 percent when compared to the season's normal cultivation area of 33.53 lakh acres. Paddy was cultivated on 64.54 lakh acres during Vaanakalam (Kharif) season of 2022-23 and 35.84 lakh acres during the Yasangi season of 2021-22.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究印度泰伦纳德那州Warangal地区的稻作物生产弹性和规模收益，以了解农业生产效率和政府政策对农民收入的影响。
AI.research_question: 泰伦纳德那州Warangal地区稻作物生产的弹性系数是多少？该地区稻作物生产是否存在规模收益？
AI.motivation: 农业在印度经济中仍然占据重要地位，超过54%的劳动力从事农业相关活动。政府采取了多项措施来提高农民收入和可持续发展。研究稻作物生产弹性和规模收益有助于制定更有效的农业政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产函数理论和弹性分析理论，通过建立生产函数模型来测度各输入因素对稻作物产量的影响程度和规模收益情况。
AI.method: 采用经验分析方法，基于Warangal地区的稻作物种植数据，通过建立生产函数模型来估计生产弹性和判断规模收益状态。
AI.findings: 稻作物在Warangal地区的种植面积显著增长（Yasangi季节增长160%），但全国范围内稻作物产量可能会下降6%。研究将揭示该地区的具体生产弹性系数和规模收益特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业生产函数理论在印度农业情境下的应用，为农业生产效率分析提供了方法论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可为泰伦纳德那州政府制定稻作物生产政策提供依据，帮助提高农民收入和保障粮食安全。

title: Artificial Writing and Automated Detection
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Artificial Writing and Automated Detection
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are increasingly used for written deliverables. This has created demand for distinguishing human-generated text from AI-generated text at scale, e.g., ensuring assignments were completed by students, product reviews written by actual customers, etc. A decision-maker aiming to implement a detector in practice must consider two key statistics: the False Negative Rate (FNR), which corresponds to the proportion of AI-generated text that is falsely classified as human, and the False Positive Rate (FPR), which corresponds to the proportion of human-written text that is falsely classified as AI-generated. We evaluate three leading commercial detectors—Pangram, OriginalityAI, GPTZero—and an open-source one —RoBERTa—on their performance in minimizing these statistics using a large corpus spanning genres, lengths, and models. Commercial detectors outperform open-source, with Pangram achieving near-zero FNR and FPR rates that remain robust across models, threshold rules, ultra-short passages, "stubs" (≤ 50 words) and ’humanizer’ tools. A decision-maker may weight one type of error (Type I vs. Type II) as more important than the other. To account for such a preference, we introduce a framework where the decision-maker sets a policy cap—a detector-independent metric reflecting tolerance for false positives or negatives. We show that Pangram is the only tool to satisfy a strict cap (FPR ≤ 0.005) without sacrificing accuracy. This framework is especially relevant given the uncertainty surrounding how AI may be used at different stages of writing, where certain uses may be encouraged (e.g., grammar correction) but may be difficult to separate from other uses.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种商业AI文本检测器(Pangram、OriginalityAI、GPTZero)和一个开源检测器(RoBERTa)的性能，发现商业检测器表现更优，其中Pangram在最小化误报率和漏报率方面表现最佳，并能满足严格的误报率上限要求。
AI.research_question: 商业AI文本检测器与开源检测器在区分AI生成文本和人类撰写文本方面的性能表现如何？
AI.motivation: 随着AI工具在写作任务中的广泛应用，需要大规模区分AI生成文本和人类撰写文本，以确保学术诚信和产品评论真实性等应用场景的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于错误分类统计框架，重点关注误报率(FPR)和漏报率(FNR)两个关键指标，并引入政策上限框架来考虑决策者对不同类型错误的偏好。
AI.method: 使用涵盖不同体裁、长度和模型的大型语料库，评估三种商业检测器和一个开源检测器的性能，测试其在各种条件下的稳健性。
AI.findings: 商业检测器表现优于开源检测器，Pangram实现接近零的误报率和漏报率，且在模型、阈值规则、超短文本和'人性化'工具等各种条件下保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个政策上限框架，允许决策者根据对误报或漏报的容忍度来设定检测器独立的标准，为AI文本检测的实际应用提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构、企业等实际应用场景提供了AI文本检测器选择的实证依据，特别是Pangram检测器在满足严格误报率要求方面的优异表现，具有重要的实践价值。

title: A Chip Off the Old Block? Genetics and the Intergenerational Transmission of Socioeconomic Status
affiliations: , University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Southern California - Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR), USC Center for Economic and Social Research and

detail.title: A Chip Off the Old Block? Genetics and the Intergenerational Transmission of Socioeconomic Status
detail.abstract: Progress in understanding the role of genetics in intergenerational socioeconomic persistence has been hampered by challenges of measurement and identification. We examine how the genetics of one generation influences the SES of the next by linking genetic data from the Dutch Lifelines Cohort to tax records for 2006-2022. Our genetic measure is the polygenic index (PGI) for educational attainment. To isolate causal genetic effects, we exploit randomness in genetic transmission across generations. One generation’s genetics impacts the education, income, and wealth of the next. A 10-percentile increase in one generation’s PGI raises next generation’s education by 0.11 years. “Next-generation genetic effects” are also large relative to “same-generation genetic effects”: a 10-percentile increase in a person’s PGI raises their income by 0.9 percentiles and their child’s by 0.7 percentiles, indicating strong persistence across generations. We next turn to mechanisms: about half of next-generation genetic effects reflect direct genetic inheritance (“genetic transmission”). The remainder operates through environmental pathways (“genetic nurture”): one generation’s genetics shapes the circumstances in which the next is raised. This environmental channel is reinforced by assortative mating: high-PGI individuals select more-educated, higher-earning partners. Our findings underscore that genetics is one of the forces anchoring SES across generations.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过创新的识别策略和大规模数据，证实了道传性基因对代际社会经济地位持续性的重要影响，并解构了直接道传和环境传递两种机制。
AI.research_question: 道传性基因如何影响代际社会经济地位的持续性？
AI.motivation: 理解道传性基因在代际社会经济持续性中的作用存在测量和识别挑战，需要创新的研究方法来解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基因道传理论、代际社会经济移动性理论、道传性基因指数(PGI)模型
AI.method: 结合荷兰Lifelines聚合的基因数据和2006-2022年税政记录，利用基因传递的随机性来隔离因果关系
AI.findings: 上一代PGI每增加10百分位点，下一代教育增加0.11年；下一代基因效应约为同代基因效应的78%；约50%通过直接道传，另一半通过环境途径(基因孵育)传递
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地证明了道传性基因在代际社会经济持续性中的重要作用，并解构了直接道传和环境传递两种机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要的科学依据，帮助理解社会不平等代际持续的根源，为干预政策提供方向性指引
